page_title: MET 2-2 REI | Metz v Reims 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+1' Oumar Diakite (Reims) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Marshall Munetsi will be replaced by Reda Khadra (Reims).
84' Here is a change. Cheikh Sabaly is going off and Laszlo Boloni gives the last tactical orders to Habib Maiga (Metz).
83' Thomas Foket (Reims) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alexandre Oukidja intercepts the ball.
80' The substitution is prepared. Pape Diallo (Metz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Joel Asoro.
80' Amir Richardson (Reims) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
79' Joseph Okumu (Reims) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for an infringement.
74' Lamine Camara (Metz) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
73' Koffi Kouao plays a beautiful lofted pass to Ablie Jallow (Metz), who somehow crashes the ball well wide of the right post from a promising position.
71' William Still decides to make a substitution. Teddy Teuma will be replaced by Keito Nakamura (Reims).
71' Amir Richardson (Reims) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mohamed Daramy.
67' Ablie Jallow (Metz) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
66' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:2.
63' 2 - 2 Ablie Jallow (Metz) scores an absolute screamer from outside the penalty area, with the ball flying into the top left corner!
63' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
62' The referee signals a substitution. Ablie Jallow (Metz) is brought on as a substitute for Simon Elisor.
60' William Still prepares a substitution. Thibault De Smet is replaced by Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims).
60' Substitution. Emmanuel Agbadou is replaced by Joseph Okumu (Reims).
58' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
55' Teddy Teuma (Reims) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
54' Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul after Koffi Kouao (Metz) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
52' 1 - 2 Goal! Teddy Teuma (Reims) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
51' Koffi Kouao (Metz) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
48' Lamine Camara (Metz) strikes the ball from the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his effort goes high over the bar.
47' Referee Mathieu Vernice sees the trip by Thomas Foket (Reims) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
47' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' Laszlo Boloni makes a switch. Christophe Herelle (Metz) is coming on in place of Sadibou Sane at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' What was Thomas Foket (Reims) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lamine Camara (Metz), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45' Simon Elisor (Metz) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Yehvann Diouf, who pulls off a stunning save!
40' The corner from Lamine Camara (Metz) is cleared away by the defence.

39' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
36' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
34' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
33' He should have done better. Oumar Diakite (Reims) is afforded space to connect with a Junya Ito cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well wide of the left post.
30' The total number of attempts is 2:5.
28' The free kick is taken by Teddy Teuma (Reims), but ball is cleared.
25' Teddy Teuma (Reims) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
24' Reims players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
23' Lamine Camara (Metz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
22' Lamine Camara (Metz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' Koffi Kouao (Metz) commits a rough foul. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and makes a call.
17' 1 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Oumar Diakite (Reims) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the top right corner.
17' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
15' A bullet header by Matthieu Udol (Metz) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar.
14' Metz have a corner.
11' Koffi Kouao (Metz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
10' Thomas Foket (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
7' 1 - 0 Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it flies straight into the top right corner of the net!

6' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
6' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
4' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) loses his marker in the box from the resulting corner, times his jump well but flashes his close-range header well wide of the right post.
4' Junya Ito (Reims) steps up to send the ball in.
1' Azor Matusiwa (Reims) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
1' The first half has just begun.
Reims will kick the game off.
Mathieu Vernice will supervise the game today.
